### executionStats

- **executionStats** · part — executionStats.executionTimeMillis covers plan selection (including the trial phase) plus execution, excludes network transfer, and is not necessarily representative of real query time: with a cached plan or cursor.hint(), plan selection is bypassed and actual time is lower than the reported value. · aka: execution stats, executionStats mode, allPlansExecution, queryPlanner mode, executionTimeMillis, executionTimeMillisEstimate, nReturned, totalKeysExamined, totalDocsExamined, keysExamined, docsExamined, works, advanced, needTime, isEOF, usedDisk, spilledRecords — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results/

### index bounds

- **index bounds** · related — **Index bounds** define the range of index values that MongoDB searches when using an index to fulfill a query. When you specify multiple query predicates on an indexed field, MongoDB attempts to combine the bounds for those predicates to produce an index scan with smaller bounds. Smaller index boun · aka: indexBounds, bounds, multikey bounds, isMultiKey, indexName, keyPattern, direction — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-multikey/multikey-index-bounds.md

### index

- **index** · hypernym — Indexes store entries in either ascending (`1`) or descending (`-1`) order. For [compound indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-compound.md#std-label-index-type-compound), sort order can determine whether the index can support a sort operation.
